item.body:
### Summary
As a visitor without an account, I want the legacy sign-in prompts (a clear title, one line of explanation, an "Ajouter un pseudo" button), so that I understand why a list is empty and can sign in from there.

Milestone: **M4** (validated legacy parity, ROADMAP). Source: operator UI comparison of 2026-11-11, side-by-side simulator captures 02, 06 (pseudos redacted, attached below when available).

### Observed (2026-11-11, first launch, no account)
- **Favoris**:
  - Legacy: "Connectez-vous pour accéder aux favoris", "Ajoutez un pseudo pour charger vos favoris et vos drapeaux.", button "Ajouter un pseudo" (`HFRswift/Swift/Favorites.swift:600-612` @ `87fe0d1c`).
  - SwiftHFR (@ `c04b89c9`, **to re-check on a current build**): "Connexion requise" then "Aucun sujet que vous avez lu n'est connu" (an empty-list text, wrong here) and "Actualiser" (useless without an account); title "Drapeaux".
- **Topic list filter** (Favoris / Suivis / Lus):
  - Legacy: icon, bold "Connexion requise pour Favoris, Suivis et Lus", subtitle "Vous pouvez consulter "Tous" sans compte."
  - SwiftHFR: the same words in one grey paragraph.

### Scope
- Favoris logged out: legacy title, text and "Ajouter un pseudo" button; no refresh.
- Topic-list reminder: legacy hierarchy (icon, bold title, subtitle).
- Favoris title and default view: "Favoris" as legacy, not "Drapeaux" (GAP-032; operator to confirm).
- GAP-037 says "same": fix its wording through the PR's `### Ledger` section.
